text:
amelia: Quick question — AE here. Customer (EU fintech) wants a 6-month POC in their VPC + the option to convert to a 12-month committed contract that only covers prod nodes. They want platform fee reduced during the POC and then only charged on prod post-conversion. Also asking for Gold support during POC and KMS/HSM onboarding. Can we structure: prorated platform fee for POC months, then conversion credit against first committed months? Need to finalize quote by EOD tomorrow. @priya @jordan

jordan: We can do prorating but 6 months is longer than our default POC window (usually <=90 days). Pattern we use: POC as a time-limited subscription with platform fee at ~50% (or capped) for short trials. For a 6mo POC we'll need Deal Desk approval for the pricing and any waivers. Splitting commit is fine — we treat the commit as one contract with an amendment that allocates % of commit to prod vs non-prod. KMS/HSM is typically a one-time onboarding fee + separate security checklist. I need an estimate of expected steady-state prod qps to size the commit.

priya: @amelia thanks — heads-up on Deal Desk rules: any POC >90 days or platform fee <50% requires DD approval. Proposed path I can start now: 1) Offer 6mo POC with 50% platform fee, capped at $10k (EU region) 2) Conversion: if customer signs a 12mo prod commit within 60 days of POC end, credit POC platform payments against the first 6 months of platform fee on the committed contract 3) Gold support: normally +15% on committed ARR; we can offer Gold at +10% during the POC as a limited promo.

priya: Example pricing snippet for the quote (put in SOW):
```
POC (6 months, EU VPC):
  - Reduced platform fee: $4,000/mo (50% of standard, capped at $24,000 total)
  - Gold support (promo): +10% on platform fee during POC
  - KMS onboarding: $3,500 one-time
Conversion to 12mo commit (prod-only):
  - Prod commit ARR: $120,000/year
  - Platform fee on commit (prod): $8,000/mo
  - Conversion credit: POC platform payments applied against first 6 months of platform fee (subject to cap)
```

priya: I'll open a Deal Desk ticket for exec approval and attach the clause language. Need confirmation if AE will accept the cap numbers or want higher.

dealdesk-bot: Deal Desk ticket created: DD-4532 — "POC >90d / platform-fee cap request". Reviewer assigned: @priya. Link: https://dealdesk.redwood.internal/DD-4532

finance-ops: Quick validation for EU region numbers. Sample calc attached: 
```
Assumptions:
  - Prod commit (12mo) = $120,000 ARR
  - Standard platform fee (prod) = $8,000/mo
  - Proposed POC platform fee = $4,000/mo (50%) for 6 months -> $24,000 total cap
  - KMS onboarding = $3,500 one-time
  - Gold support = 15% on committed platform fee (promo 10% during POC)
Conversion credit logic OK: credit up to POC platform payments applied against first 6 months of post-conversion platform fee.
Notes: If commit is sized down after conversion, credits should be prorated; billing/legal need amendment language.
```

ameilia: (typo) sorry — will send corrected SOW.

amelia: Got it, thanks. I'll: 1) update the POC SOW with the pricing example above and the conversion-credit language, 2) ask the customer for expected prod qps/instances so we can size the commit, 3) request their security questionnaire (they'll need SOC2 + pen test report for KMS/HSM). @priya please add the conversion clause template to DD-4532 and tag legal for amendment language.

priya: Done — clause added and legal looped in. Also note: if they want billing split (POC billed to one entity, commit to another) we need partner ops/finance sign-off; that typically slows close.

jordan: :thumbsup: If we get the usage estimates today I can prototype the dedicated pool sizing and confirm latency SLAs for Gold.

finance-ops: One more ops note — for EU onprem/VPC with HSM we usually require a one-week lead time for provisioning once contract terms are signed. Add that into the SOW timeline.

amelia: Perfect. I'll push the updated SOW + security checklist to the customer and update the quote once DD-4532 has an initial response. Will ping if they want the platform fee waiver increased.

priya: Closing loop here — I'll escalate DD-4532 to get morning exec sign-off so you can meet EOD quote deadline.

(jordan reacted with :eyes:)
